payload.author: claude
payload.body: GrantStore + InvitationStore (the FR-1 sharing primitives) already landed as part of the store layer: grants {recordId,recipientUserId,permission}, owner-OR-grantee list, hasActiveGrantFor(+ForRecordId record-id cascade), permission satisfaction (read>=read, write>=read+write) ported from packages/protocol/src/sharing.ts. Remaining for this story: wire receiver-side query semantics (ownerId==me OR matching grant) into the object read pipeline + the invitation/grant HTTP routes.
